summary: Payments-gateway 3.8.0 (jk:payments-gateway-deploy#412, snow:CHG0031877) added three retries with an 8 s timeout around the PayCore authorize call, inside a database transaction (conf:KB0010502). PayCore's EU edge slowed from 14:24 (dt:P-26101350), so each slow authorization now holds a connection for up to 39 s; the gateway pools hit their limit (spl:alert/891f48a7) and pay-db-01 fills with idle-in-transaction sessions (snow:jn/ec7656f6). checkout-api times out on the gateway, which is the 504s. The checkout rollback changed nothing (jk:checkout-api-deploy#898). Roll the gateway back to 3.7.9 now.

impact.oncall: Priya Raman (Payments Engineering level 2, acknowledged pd:oncall/fafc2fbc); the CMDB owner is inactive
impact.customer: payment submissions failing or slow; browsing and cart unaffected

actions.action: Roll payments-gateway back to 3.7.9 (or disable the new retries) now.
Pause the payments-reconciler run to free 40 connections as headroom while the rollback goes out; it is relief, not the fix.
Audit authorizations for duplicates from retries and customer resubmits, and update support and customers.
